# 2 bed detached house for sale

> 4-Room Cottage on a 0.75-Acre Site Located in pleasant rural countryside along a country laneway, this stone-built cottage needs significant upgrading but has considerable potential. The cottage comprises four separate rooms. To the front is a large garden area that could have multiple uses. To the rear are two large blocks of sheds, divided into units of different sizes.

- Typ: detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 2 bed
- Plocha: 50 m²
- Energetická náročnost: G
- Lokalita: Cuilmore, Gurteen
